brief.headline: Push for a price closer to the ₹250/kg market typical and qualify a listed converter (Huhtamaki or UFLEX) as a second source — Silk Polypack publishes no financials, so we lean on market data and backup options.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for a price closer to the market typical of ₹250/kg for pharma laminate sachets.
priceAsk.basis: The market asking band for pharma/ORS sachet laminate is ₹205–305/kg, with ₹250/kg typical. Our current price sits at the top of the fair band, so there's room to move toward the middle.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay 15 days earlier (move from 30 days after receipt to 15 days after receipt) in exchange for part of the price cut.
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 15 days earlier would tie up an extra ₹320 of our cash, so the price cut must save us more than that to make it worth our while.

brief.financialLeverage: Silk Polypack is a private supplier and does not publish financials, so we have no window into how healthy or cash-tight they are. Our annual spend with them is ₹7775 — a very small account for any converter, which limits how hard we can push on price alone. The real leverage is supply-security: we have two strong listed converters (Huhtamaki and UFLEX) already in the market who can take this laminate work at scale, and several film-maker leads to check substrate costs. Line up one of those converters now so Silk Polypack knows a second source is ready if terms don't improve.

evidence.point: Market asking price for pharma/ORS sachet laminate runs ₹205–305/kg, with ₹250/kg typical — verdict is market-fair at the top of the band.
Import unit value for BOPET film (the base substrate) is ₹171.60/kg.
Our annual spend with Silk Polypack is only ₹7775.
Paying 15 days earlier than our current 30 Days After Receipt would tie up an extra ₹320 of our cash.
Silk Polypack does not publish financials.

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexible-packaging converter already a tiny FDC supplier — a proven, scalable second source for laminate sachets.

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant covering both film substrate and conversion — can second-source at scale.

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Constantia group's India converter for pharma blister and sachet laminates — strong second-source option (health score D 31/100, revenue ₹222.04 Cr).

risks: Our ₹7775 annual spend is too small to command much attention — Silk Polypack may not move much on price unless we grow the volume or they see a real second-source threat.
No published financials means we can't tell if they're cash-tight or comfortable — so we can't gauge how far to push without breaking the relationship.
If we push hard and they walk, we need a qualified second source lined up first — start the RFQ with Huhtamaki or UFLEX before this meeting.
Paying earlier ties up ₹320 more of our cash for every 15 days, so only accept faster payment if the price cut saves us more than that.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to work toward the ₹250/kg market midpoint for this laminate and talk about how faster payment might help you — but we're also qualifying a second converter to make sure our supply is secure.
